lines.heard: Take Ln of both sides. Add power splits the right side.
lines.said: Take L N of both sides. Add Power splits the right side.

lines.heard: LN cancels E, leaving minus N X. So LNY equals minus N times X plus LNA.
lines.said: L N cancels E, leaving minus N X. So L N Y equals minus N, times X, plus L N A.

lines.heard: LNA is minus one, unlog A is E to the power minus one, about 0.368.
lines.said: L N A is minus one. Un-log: A is E to the power minus one, about zero point three six eight.
